# PaneCrew

> PaneCrew is a free, open-source (MIT) desktop app for macOS and Windows that runs multiple
> real, simultaneously visible terminal sessions in one grid, paired with a file explorer that
> automatically follows whichever pane currently has focus. Tool-agnostic: hosts any CLI coding
> agent — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, or a plain shell — equally well. <!-- brandlint-ok: functional list of supported CLI tools, matches README/homepage wording -->

- [Homepage](https://panecrew.dev/): product overview, feature grid, nightly builds
- [How to Run Multiple CLI Coding Agent Sessions](https://panecrew.dev/guides/multiple-cli-agent-sessions/): guide + FAQ on running Claude Code/Codex/Gemini CLI in parallel <!-- brandlint-ok: functional list of supported CLI tools, matches the guide page's own copy -->
